about.description:
pyhmeasure exposes the Rust hmeasure crate to Python. The H-measure, introduced by
David J. Hand, is a coherent alternative to the area under the ROC curve (AUC) for
assessing binary classifiers: it fixes the distribution of misclassification costs
consistently across all classifiers being compared.
about.summary: Python bindings to a Rust implementation of the H-measure for assessing binary classifiers

raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "0.1.0"

package:
  name: pyhmeasure
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://github.com/robinwiseman/pyhmeasure/archive/refs/tags/v${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: dba402f274f665f635eea2c9ebb94ff7dd91ea17eecdb26769fa8f5a9abc3b4d

build:
  number: 0
  script:
    env:
      CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_STRIP: symbols
    content:
      - ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv
      - cargo-bundle-licenses --format yaml --output THIRDPARTY.yml

requirements:
  build:
    - if: build_platform != host_platform
      then:
        - python
        - cross-python_${{ host_platform }}
    - ${{ compiler("c") }}
    - ${{ compiler("rust") }}
    - ${{ stdlib("c") }}
    - cargo-bundle-licenses
  host:
    - maturin >=1.9.4,<2.0
    - pip
    - python
  run:
    - python

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - pyhmeasure
      pip_check: true
  - files:
      source:
        - tests/
        - python_src/
    requirements:
      run:
        - numpy
        - pandas
        - scipy
        - pytest
        - pytest-benchmark
    script:
      # the 360,000 score benchmarks are skipped to keep the build quick
      - python -m pytest tests -v --benchmark-disable -k "not large"

about:
  homepage: https://github.com/robinwiseman/pyhmeasure
  repository: https://github.com/robinwiseman/pyhmeasure
  summary: Python bindings to a Rust implementation of the H-measure for assessing binary classifiers
  description: |
    pyhmeasure exposes the Rust hmeasure crate to Python. The H-measure, introduced by
    David J. Hand, is a coherent alternative to the area under the ROC curve (AUC) for
    assessing binary classifiers: it fixes the distribution of misclassification costs
    consistently across all classifiers being compared.
  license: MIT
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - THIRDPARTY.yml
    # Rust dependencies that do not ship a licence file of their own
    - license-files/hmeasure-LICENSE
    - license-files/quadrature-LICENSE
    - license-files/r-efi-AUTHORS

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - robinwiseman
